items.title: 1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach

items.title: 13 Malicious NuGet Packages Turn Fake .NET Job Assessments Into Malware Delivery Traps

items.title: 1Password Hacked – Attackers Breach Backend Systems and Steal Customer Data
items.description: 1Password disclosed on November 25, 2026, that an attacker compromised an employee’s corporate GitHub account and used it to steal customer data from the company’s backend systems.
